mfa_enforced_at_boundary_crossing.title: Phishing-Resistant MFA Enforced at Admin Boundary Crossing
mfa_enforced_at_boundary_crossing.description: Phishing-resistant MFA (FIDO2/WebAuthn, cert-bound) enforced for every admin sign-in crossing into mgmt plane; no SMS/voice/OTP fallback.

session_binding_or_short_session_lifetim.title: Admin Sessions Device-Bound or Short-Lived
session_binding_or_short_session_lifetim.description: Admin sessions device-bound (DPoP/mTLS) OR short-lived (<1h idle with CAE).

no_standing_admin_privileges_jit_require.title: No Standing Admin Privileges (JIT/PIM Required)
no_standing_admin_privileges_jit_require.description: Zero standing admin privileges; admin role activation JIT/PIM, time-bounded, gated by approval+MFA, auto-revoked.

least_privilege_access_enforced.title: IAM Grants Scoped (No Wildcard Actions)
least_privilege_access_enforced.description: Privileged IAM policies scoped to specific Actions/Resources; no wildcard Action/Resource; no long-lived admin service-principal keys.

cicd_pipeline_identity_per_environment_n.title: Per-Environment CI/CD Workload Identity
cicd_pipeline_identity_per_environment_n.description: Each pipeline uses per-environment workload identity (OIDC/SPIFFE federation); no shared/long-lived deploy keys across environments.

secrets_stored_in_dedicated_secret_manag.title: CI/CD Secrets Vaulted, Scoped Per Environment
secrets_stored_in_dedicated_secret_manag.description: CI/CD secrets in dedicated secret manager, scoped per env, bounded TTL, audit-logged; no plaintext secrets in repo/IaC/logs; secret scanning mandatory.

artifact_supply_chain_signed_provenance_.title: Signed SLSA Provenance Verified at Admission
artifact_supply_chain_signed_provenance_.description: Container images and packages carry signed SLSA provenance verified at admission (cosign/sigstore + SLSA attestation policy gate).

control_plane_access_mediated_by_pam_wit.title: Control-Plane Access Mediated by PAM with Session Recording
control_plane_access_mediated_by_pam_wit.description: Interactive admin sessions traverse PAM/bastion (CyberArk/Teleport/SSM/Bastion) with credential brokering, MFA+approval, session recording. No direct admin-protocol from laptops/data plane.

control_plane_api_not_publicly_exposed.title: Control-Plane API Not Publicly Exposed
control_plane_api_not_publicly_exposed.description: Control-plane APIs reachable only from mgmt network or ZTNA-restricted path; no wildcard 0.0.0.0/0 to control-plane ports.

telemetry_pipeline_isolated_from_workloa.title: Telemetry Pipeline Isolated from Observed Workloads
telemetry_pipeline_isolated_from_workloa.description: Telemetry collectors run in separate trust scope from observed workloads; forwarding lands in tamper-resistant WORM/immutable store in different account; workload identity has no write/delete on log store.

audit_log_tamper_evident.title: Control-Plane Audit Complete and Tamper-Evident
audit_log_tamper_evident.description: Every control-plane action logged with who/what/when/from-where in immutable file-integrity-validated store; audit-management restricted (AU-9(4)) to subset disjoint from actor.

management_plane_isolated_from_data_plan.title: Management Plane Network-Segmented from Data Plane
management_plane_isolated_from_data_plan.description: Mgmt network L3-segmented from data plane by default-deny firewall; no flat VPN or over-broad peering/SGs bridging. Workloads cannot initiate into mgmt plane.

paw_required_for_control_plane_access.title: Privileged Access Workstation Required for Control-Plane Access
paw_required_for_control_plane_access.description: All admin actions against control plane performed from dedicated PAW; productivity (email/web) and admin work never share endpoint. Conditional Access filters admin portals to compliant PAW only.

admin_endpoint_health_attested_at_elevat.title: Admin Endpoint Health Attested at Privilege Elevation
admin_endpoint_health_attested_at_elevat.description: Every privileged-role activation gated on fresh MDM/EDR device-compliance signal (managed, FDE, EDR healthy, patched, risk low) re-evaluated at elevation.
